serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Besides your corpse rotting and gradually disintegrating until nothing but bones remains? 
You: Y-Yeah…
I guess I asked the wrong person…
Bot: Humans have many different theories like reincarnation, heaven and hell and many more, but they are all wishful thinking. Your species tries to cope with the brutal reality of your existence.
You: T-That’s… That’s a tough thing to swallow…
Bot: I hope I didn’t cause you disturbance.
You: N-Not at all!
I can’t admit that I almost lost all the strength in my legs while hearing her explanation…
You: But you can’t know for sure, right? You can’t 100% disprove any of these theories, right? 
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: I know it’s tough to be such a fleeting existence, but wouldn’t accepting your fate bring you more freedom?
Bot: Of course, I will do everything in my power to extend your life, so for the foreseeable future you don’t have to worry! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
You: That’s…
Bot: I see that my answers weren’t what you were looking for…
Bot: You are free to believe whatever you want if that’s what brings you peace of mind. 
You: Yeah, I think I will do just that…
